correctness.rationale: Local validity is under every valuation, not a random labeling. For successor set S, D iff S nonempty, B iff every child returns to root, 4 iff each child out-neighborhood lies in S, and 5 iff S empty (irreflexive). The McKinsey implication is valid iff its child-successor hypergraph admits no red/blue assignment meeting and missing every nonempty child-edge. Outside reciprocal arcs, two-hop triangles, and common-child collisions, local profile depends only on first two generations: v0=(0,1,1,1,0), v1=(1,0,1,0,1), v2=(1,0,0,0,1), v3=(1,0,0,0,0). Independent outgoing rows give an exact finite multinomial canonical law with s_n,t_n,u_n, bounded error O((c²+c³+c⁴/2)/n). Efron–Stein influence ≤1+indegree gives O(1/n) variance; limits s=e^-c,t=e^{-c(1−e^-c)},u=e^{-c(1+c)e^-c}. M frequency 1−u is maximized uniquely at c=(1+sqrt5)/2 by derivative of c(1+c)e^-c. The n>max(2,c), fixed c>0, no-loop and all-valuation hypotheses matter.
